changelog:
Initial release offering targeted, automated troubleshooting for Alibaba Cloud ECS and VPC public network connectivity issues:

- Diagnoses ECS public network access, including public IP reachability and security group blocking, with automatic handling of NAT-gateway scenarios.
- Troubleshoots VPC cloud service (DataWorks, SAE, ACK, etc.) public network connectivity, checking NAT gateway, SNAT, routing, and EIP.
- All diagnostics performed strictly by designated Python scripts; no manual credential handling or CLI/SDK logic allowed.
- Enforces mandatory input checks and user confirmation of scope before any API interaction.
- Provides clear error reporting and aborts on missing parameters or script/credential failures.
